properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 8 at 11:01AM CDT until September 9 at 8:20PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Texas...

Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Hardin,
Jasper, Orange and Jefferson Counties.

For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pine Island Bayou near Sour Lake.

* WHEN...Until Wednesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 25.0 feet, Water inundates roads in lowland areas near
the river. Low spots on Old Sour Lake Road are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:45 AM CDT Tuesday the stage was 26.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 10:45 AM CDT Tuesday was 27.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 19.4 feet Sunday
morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 26.7
feet on 04/24/1977.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 1215 PM CDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL WEDNESDAY EVENING

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 8 at 8:48PM CDT until September 8 at 9:15PM CDT by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
properties.description:
At 848 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Fairfax to Tiffin to near Wellman, moving east at 50
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Marengo, Marion, Coralville, North Liberty,
Mount Vernon, Williamsburg, Kalona, Lisbon, Fairfax, Solon, Tiffin,
Ely, Atkins, Walford, Wellman, University Heights, Riverside, and
Swisher.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 80 in Iowa between mile markers 219 and 251.
Interstate 380 between mile markers 1 and 22.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
sturdy building.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

NWSheadline: A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 915 PM CDT FOR NORTHEASTERN KEOKUK...JOHNSON...SOUTHEASTERN BENTON...NORTHERN WASHINGTON...SOUTHERN LINN AND EASTERN IOWA COUNTIES

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 8 at 8:50PM CDT until September 8 at 9:15PM CDT by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
properties.description:
TORDVN

The National Weather Service in the Quad Cities has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
North central Johnson County in east central Iowa...
Southern Linn County in east central Iowa...

* Until 915 PM CDT.

* At 849 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Cedar Rapids Municipal Airport, or near Cedar
Rapids, moving northeast at 50 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Cedar Rapids, Marion, Ely, Bertram, Marion Airport, and Wanatee
Park around 855 PM CDT.
Springville and Paralta around 900 PM CDT.
Whittier around 905 PM CDT.

This includes Interstate 380 between mile markers 10 and 23.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

Tornadoes are extremely difficult to see and confirm at night. Do not
wait to see or hear the tornado. TAKE COVER NOW!

This cluster of thunderstorms is capable of producing tornadoes and
widespread significant wind damage. Do not wait to see or hear the
tornado. For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest
floor of a building.

CMAMtext: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 9:15 PM CDT. Take shelter now. Check media.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 9:15 PM CDT. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 8 at 6:29PM CDT until September 9 at 12:30AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
FFWDMX

The National Weather Service in Des Moines has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Eastern Dallas County in central Iowa...
Polk County in central Iowa...

* Until 1230 AM CDT Wednesday.

* At 629 PM CDT, trained weather spotters reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches
of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is already
occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Trained spotters reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Des Moines, West Des Moines, Ankeny, Urbandale, Johnston, Clive,
Altoona, Pleasant Hill, Grimes, Windsor Heights, Carlisle,
Bondurant, Polk City, Saylorville, Mitchellville, Adventureland
Amusement Park, Iowa State Fairgrounds and Prairie Meadows.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 80 between mile markers 121 and 149. Interstate 235 near
mile marker 1...and between mile markers 10 and 14...and between mile
markers 2 and 9. Interstate 35 between mile markers 100 and 102...and
between mile markers 68 and 99.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.
